title: Lovable alternatives
summary: Lovable alternatives: candidate paths, switching costs and reasons to keep the original.

sections.heading: Match the reason to a candidate
paragraphs: Bolt and Replit are candidates for a guided app-building trial. Cursor is a different path for someone ready to implement and operate the application directly; it is not presented as an equivalent hosted app builder.

sections.heading: When to keep the original
paragraphs: Keep Lovable if the prototype fits and a real export rehearsal succeeds. A new builder will not eliminate the need to own security and live-app costs.

sections.heading: Migration rehearsal
paragraphs: Create a copy of the project, remove production secrets, export data using a documented method and run the tests in the candidate workflow. Compare the work needed to restore service after a failed change. Keep the original until the rehearsal succeeds.

verdict: Determine whether you want another app builder or direct control of the repository.
bestFor: Existing Lovable users with a specific workflow, budget or ownership constraint
notFor: Readers expecting a replacement to move code, data and infrastructure automatically
migration: Trial the candidate on a branch; retain the original workflow until tests, export and billing checks pass.
